pluginConfigFields.label: Simulated RF Explorer Pro
pluginConfigFields.help: Adds a pretend RF Explorer Pro to the device picker, drawing its screen the way a real one does, so the plugin can be tried without the hardware. Real units are added by IP address.

deviceConfigFields.label: IP address
deviceConfigFields.help: The RF Explorer Pro's address, shown in its network settings. Connect it with a USB-to-Ethernet adapter on its USB 3.0 Type-A port. Cabled straight to this computer it gets a 169.254.x.x address.

deviceConfigFields.label: VNC password
deviceConfigFields.help: Leave empty unless a VNC password was set on the Pro. Note that SoundBase stores it unencrypted in the project.
